itineraries.title: Carrboro Second Friday: FRANK Gallery, NC Botanical Garden, Wine Tasting, Art Walk, Deerhoof at Cat's Cradle
itineraries.theme: A gallery day that ends at Carrboro's Second Friday Art Walk and a show at Cat's Cradle, with a garden walk in Chapel Hill in between
itineraries.drive_time: Carrboro is about 26 mi (straight line) west-northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 35-45 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). The NC Botanical Garden is about 2 mi from FRANK Gallery. The evening stops are within a few blocks of each other.
itineraries.cost_range: Events free except the Cat's Cradle show (price not in the store; see the ticket link); about $40-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Friday is sunny with a high of 58°F and a low near 36°F at night. Have an açaí bowl at The Purple Bowl in Chapel Hill, see the featured artists exhibit at FRANK Gallery from 11 AM, and have lunch at Akai Hana. Walk the NC Botanical Garden in the afternoon. Back in Carrboro, Weaver Street Market pours a free wine tasting from 5 PM, Glasshalfull opens for dinner at 5 PM, and the Second Friday Art Walk runs 6-9 PM at FRANK Gallery and Peel Gallery. Deerhoof plays Cat's Cradle at 8 PM.

morning.notes: Listed 11 AM-7 PM. Work by member artists Keith Allen, Shelly Hehenberger, Mary Lee Kerr and Donna Stubbs and guest artist Polina Varlamova. Info: https://www.visitchapelhill.org/event/frank-featured-artists-exhibit-%7c-september-november-2026/35022/

afternoon.title: NC Botanical Garden display gardens (self-guided; not a stored event)
afternoon.location: North Carolina Botanical Garden, 100 Old Mason Farm Road, Chapel Hill, NC
afternoon.notes: Garden's visit page: display gardens open 9 AM-5 PM Tuesday-Sunday, no ticket or fee, donations welcome. https://ncbg.unc.edu/visit/

afternoon.title: Free Wine Tasting!
afternoon.location: Weaver Street Market Carrboro, 101 East Weaver St, Carrboro, NC 27510
afternoon.notes: 5-7 PM. Weekly Friday tasting at all Weaver Street Market stores. Info: https://www.visitchapelhill.org/event/free-wine-tasting!/32673/

evening.title: Second Friday Art Walk
evening.location: FRANK Gallery, 370 E. Main St #130, Carrboro, NC 27510
evening.notes: 6-9 PM. FRANK Gallery's monthly Second Friday reception. Info: https://www.frankisart.com/event/second-friday-art-walk-15/

evening.title: Opening Reception for POSTERITY by Brian Gonzales
evening.location: Peel Gallery + Photo Lab, 708 West Rosemary Street, Carrboro, NC 27516
evening.notes: 6-9 PM. Opening reception for Brian Gonzales's solo exhibition. Info: https://www.peel.gallery/upcoming-copy

food.vegetarian_dish: Simple Bowl (classic base of açaí, banana, strawberries, hemp milk; topped with almonds, banana, strawberries)

Own menu PDF: all bowls are served with granola and a touch of honey; Snack $8.50, Regular $12.50, Giant $15.50. Vegetarian by its listed ingredients, not labeled. Own lunch menu, section headed "Vegetarian Appetizers": Vegetable Tempura $10.95, Deluxe Appetizer Sampler $12.95, Agedashi Tofu $6.95. The menu does not say whether the tempura sauce is vegetarian. No vegan dish verified.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, high 58°F, 1% chance of rain. The display gardens close at 5 PM.
alternatives.rain: The Ackland Art Museum (101 S. Columbia Street, Chapel Hill) is free and its visit page lists Second Friday hours of 10 AM-9 PM. https://ackland.org/visit/

alternatives.leg: Walking between Weaver Street Market, the galleries and Cat's Cradle (outdoor, short)
alternatives.good_weather: Partly cloudy and falling toward 36°F after dark; bring a warm layer.
alternatives.rain: All four venues are indoors. An indoor alternative to the concert is the improv show "Won't You Be My Neighbor? | Comedy Improv (Rated R)" at the ArtsCenter, 400 Roberson Street, 8:30 PM, $15 (event 5b1cbc012cee; https://www.blacksheepcomedy.com/shows/wont-you-be-my-neighbor).

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:15 AM for breakfast at The Purple Bowl at about 9 AM; FRANK Gallery opens at 11 AM.
Route: I-40 west to Chapel Hill, then Franklin Street/Main Street into Carrboro (route not checked against a routing service).
Suggested evening order: wine tasting at 5 PM, dinner at Glasshalfull at 5:30 PM, galleries from about 6:45 PM, Cat's Cradle at 8 PM.
Parking: Glasshalfull's site says parking is adjacent to the restaurant. Parking for the galleries, Weaver Street Market and Cat's Cradle was not verified.
A separate listing covers the town-wide 2nd Friday Art Walk (event f332c7d3d11e; https://engage.carrboronc.gov/2nd-friday-art-walk).
Cat's Cradle Back Room has a second 8 PM show the same night: Jacob Sharp's album release (event 4cf991a86fda).

itineraries.title: Durham Makers Day: Craft Market, Mountains to Sea Showcase at The Glass Jug, Liberty Arts Iron Pour, Improv at Mettlesome
itineraries.theme: Handmade goods in the morning, a North Carolina beer, wine and cider tasting in the afternoon, an iron pour at dusk and improv comedy at night
itineraries.drive_time: Durham Central Park is about 21 mi (straight line) northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 30-40 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). The Glass Jug Beer Lab in RTP is about 8 mi south of Durham Central Park; Mettlesome is about 1 mi east of it.
itineraries.cost_range: Market, showcase entry and iron pour free; Mettlesome $9; tasting purchases extra; about $40-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Saturday is mostly sunny with a high of 54°F, and clear with a low near 34°F at night. Have breakfast at Monuts, then walk the Durham Craft Market at Durham Central Park (8 AM-noon), next to the farmers' market. Have lunch at Luna Rotisserie downtown, then drive to The Glass Jug Beer Lab in RTP for the Mountains to Sea Showcase (noon-6 PM). Return to Durham Central Park for the Liberty Arts Iron Pour (4-9 PM), have pizza at Cugino Forno, and see Show And Tell & Pivot Point at Mettlesome at 7 PM.

morning.title: Durham Craft Market

afternoon.title: Mountains to Sea Showcase

The event page mentions VIP tickets; general entry is listed as free. Registration: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/mountains-to-sea-showcase-tickets-1998498703420 Info: https://www.glass-jug.com/events/mountainstosea

afternoon.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 4-9 PM. 10th annual iron pour by Liberty Arts. Pour schedule was not posted on the listing. Organizer page: https://www.libertyartsnc.org/iron-pour Info: https://durhamcentralpark.org/upcoming-event/liberty-arts-iron-pour-2/

evening.location: Mettlesome, 800 Taylor St. Suite 9-156, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: 7-8 PM. Improv built on true stories, plus the house team Pivot Point. Info: https://thisismettlesome.com/live/2026/11/14/show-and-tell-pivot-point

food.vegetarian_dish: Seasonal Granola Bowl (greek yogurt, maple-pecan granola, apple compote); All You Avo' Wanted with the fruit salad choice

Own menu PDF (Fall 2026): Seasonal Granola Bowl $7; All You Avo' Wanted $16 (avocado toast, two local farm eggs, maple sriracha home fries, with a choice of bacon, sausage or fruit salad). Own menu: Marinara (No Cheese) $18.95, marked vegan; Margherita D.O.P $20.95; Funghi $22.95. The menu page is shared by all locations; Durham prices may differ.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny; it will be cold early, so arrive after 9:30 AM and dress warmly.
alternatives.rain: No indoor morning event was verified. Start later with lunch at Luna, then go to The Glass Jug Beer Lab, which the store lists as indoor (the tasting itself is described as in the beer garden).

alternatives.good_weather: Clear and near freezing later in the evening; bring a coat. The pour is easiest to see after dark.
alternatives.rain: Go to Mettlesome early: The Lottery, a student and house-team improv show, is at 5 PM, $8 at the door (event 402f1c37cbc4; https://thisismettlesome.com/live/2026/11/14/the-lottery).

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:15 AM for breakfast at Monuts at about 9 AM.
Route: I-40 west to NC 147 north for downtown Durham; The Glass Jug Beer Lab is at 5410 NC 55 near I-40 (route not checked against a routing service).
The afternoon stop is an alcohol tasting followed by more driving; plan a designated driver.
Parking was not verified for Durham Central Park, The Glass Jug or Golden Belt (800 Taylor St.).
Mettlesome's listing gives no advance booking link for the 7 PM show; see https://thisismettlesome.com/live/2026/11/14/show-and-tell-pivot-point
A later Mettlesome show the same night: The Racket at 8 PM, $8 (event a93047404f59).

itineraries.title: Raleigh Family Day: Hug-A-Tree at Umstead State Park, Vegan Lunch, Lighting of the Tree at Lafayette Village
itineraries.theme: A family day in north Raleigh: a ranger-led woods-safety program for children at Umstead State Park, then a holiday tree lighting with live music and carriage rides
itineraries.drive_time: Umstead State Park's Crabtree Creek entrance is about 10 mi (straight line) northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 20-25 min by car. Lafayette Village is about 9 mi east of the park and about 8 mi north of downtown, roughly 15-25 min each (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Both events free; about $45-$60 per person for meals (A Place at the Table is pay-what-you-can)
itineraries.overview: Saturday is mostly sunny with a high of 54°F, dropping toward 34°F on a clear night. Have breakfast downtown at A Place at the Table, then take children aged about 7-11 to the free Hug-A-Tree program at Umstead State Park (10 AM-noon). Have lunch at The Fiction Kitchen, an all-vegan restaurant on Crabtree Blvd. The Lighting of the Tree at Lafayette Village runs 3-6 PM with live music and horse-and-carriage rides; the tree is lit at 6 PM. Have dinner at Farina Neighborhood Italian in the same complex.

morning.notes: 10 AM-noon. For children around ages 7-11 with a parent or guardian. An indoor instruction session is followed by a guided walk. The info link is the registration form. Info: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/g/attCLcdu6P

Vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified. Saturday dinner hours were not found on the site; call (919) 890-0143.

alternatives.leg: Hug-A-Tree guided walk at Umstead State Park (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny, high 54°F, 8% chance of rain; the morning will be colder, so dress children in layers.
alternatives.rain: Indoor options: Incredible Science at the NC Museum of Natural Sciences, 11 West Jones Street, 12:30-1 PM (event 0a229e9c59c3; price not in the store), or the free 1 PM Public Tour at the NC Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Road (event 3837025a3e6b).

alternatives.leg: Lighting of the Tree at Lafayette Village (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Clear and cooling quickly after dark; bring coats for the 6 PM lighting.
alternatives.rain: The NC Symphony plays How to Train Your Dragon live to the film at Meymandi Concert Hall, 2 East South Street, at 3 PM, starting at $63 (event 754c6eb0c6b7; https://www.martinmariettacenter.com/events/detail/how-to-train-your-dragon).

practical_notes: Suggested start: breakfast at A Place at the Table at 8:15 AM; leave downtown by 9:20 AM for the 10 AM program.
Hug-A-Tree registration form: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/g/attCLcdu6P . The park entrance is at 8801 Glenwood Ave.
Route: Glenwood Avenue (US 70) to the park; I-540 or Lynn Road east to Honeycutt Road for Lafayette Village (route not checked against a routing service).
Parking was not verified for Umstead State Park, The Fiction Kitchen or Lafayette Village.

The store also holds a listing for the symphony concert at 7:30 PM Saturday (event 028a3da8cc34). The NC Symphony's own page lists only Friday 7:30 PM and Saturday 3 PM, so this itinerary does not use it.

itineraries.title: Pittsboro Sunday: Breakfast at Fearrington, Lower Haw River Walk, Fourth Annual Chestnut Carnival at The Plant
itineraries.theme: A Chatham County outdoor day: a riverside walk at Bynum and a free chestnut festival with a talk on chestnuts as a food crop
itineraries.drive_time: The Plant in Pittsboro is about 30 mi (straight line) west-southwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 40-50 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). Fearrington Village is about 7 mi north of The Plant; the Bynum river access is about 4 mi north of it.
itineraries.cost_range: Carnival and walk free; food and drink at the carnival extra; about $45-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Sunday is sunny with a high of 55°F and no rain in the forecast. Have breakfast at The Belted Goat in Fearrington Village, then walk by the Haw River at the Lower Haw River State Natural Area's Bynum access. Have an early lunch at Elizabeth's Pizza in Pittsboro and spend the afternoon at the Fourth Annual Chestnut Carnival at The Plant (noon-6 PM): roasted chestnuts, chestnut beer and cocktails, and a 2 PM talk, Chestnut 101. Have dinner at Doherty's Irish Pub before driving home.

morning.price: Free (no fee found on the state parks page; not confirmed)

afternoon.title: Fourth Annual Chestnut Carnival

afternoon.notes: Noon-6 PM. The Plant's page: opening bell at noon; chestnuts roasting over an open fire, chestnut beer, cocktails and Fair Game's Chestnut Rum Cream. The Plant's own page: https://www.theplantnc.com/event-details/4th-annual-chestnut-carnival Info: https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/fourth-annual-chestnut-carnival/

afternoon.title: Chestnut 101: The Past, Present & Future of Chestnuts (talk within the Chestnut Carnival)
afternoon.location: The Plant, 220 Lorax Lane, Pittsboro, NC 27312
afternoon.notes: Listed on The Plant's event page: chestnuts as a sustainable food crop and how chestnut flour is made. https://www.theplantnc.com/event-details/4th-annual-chestnut-carnival

evening.title: Chestnut Carnival closes; dinner in Pittsboro (not a stored event)

food.notes: Own daily menu page (read through a page-summary tool, not raw text): Donegal $18 and Goat Cheese Salad $15 are labeled vegetarian; daily menu served every day until 10 PM. alternatives.leg: Lower Haw River walk at Bynum (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, high 55°F, 0% chance of rain; the morning will be near 40°F, so wear layers.
alternatives.rain: Stay at Fearrington Village after breakfast. McIntyre's Books hosts author Craig Johnson with actor A. Martinez at the Fearrington Barn, 500 Market Street, 2-3 PM (event f73b727eabaf; price not in the store; https://visitpittsboro.com/event/craig-johnson-have-courage/).

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and cool; stay for the 2 PM talk and leave by the 6 PM close.
alternatives.rain: The store holds two listings for this carnival; one marks it outdoor and the other indoor. Check The Plant's page for a rain plan before driving out: https://www.theplantnc.com/event-details/4th-annual-chestnut-carnival

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:15 AM for breakfast at The Belted Goat at 9 AM (breakfast ends at 11 AM).
Route: US 64 west to Pittsboro, or US 64 to US 15-501 north for Fearrington Village and Bynum (route not checked against a routing service).
Parking was not verified at any stop. The Plant's site has an "Overflow Parking" page.
A guided walk at the same Bynum access at 9 AM, "Take a Walk on the Wild Side", is marked sold out in the store (event 85c3508ee198), so this itinerary uses a self-guided walk.
The store has two listings for the carnival (25bde0154ed8 and 5a357f66e2eb); one calls it the fourth annual and the other the third. The Plant's own page says 4th Annual.

itineraries.title: Cary and Apex Sunday: Yoga and Beer at Bond Brothers, A World in Three Voices at The Halle, Joe Zimmerman at Raleigh Improv
itineraries.theme: An indoor Sunday close to Raleigh: a brewery yoga class, a chamber concert for violin, trumpet and piano, and stand-up comedy
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Cary is about 8 mi (straight line) west of downtown Raleigh, roughly 15-20 min by car. The Halle in Apex is about 5 mi southwest of downtown Cary, and Raleigh Improv in west Cary is about 6 mi north of The Halle, roughly 10-15 min each (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Concert $18 adult; comedy $26.67; yoga price not in the store; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Sunday is sunny with a high of 55°F; every stop is indoors. Have brunch at La Farm Bakery in downtown Cary, then take the 10:45 AM Yoga and Beer class at Bond Brothers Beer Company (walk-ins welcome). Have lunch at SAAP, drive to Apex for the 3 PM Classical Concert Series program at The Halle Cultural Arts Center, and eat an early dinner at Daniel's. Joe Zimmerman performs at Raleigh Improv in Cary at 6 PM.

alternatives.rain: The Cary Theater, 122 E. Chatham St., shows "Take Me Home" at noon (event 4531fc106347; price not in the store; https://thecarytheater.com/events-list/). It may run too long to fit lunch at SAAP, which closes at 2 PM.

Suggested timing: lunch at SAAP at 12:15 PM, leave Cary by 2:30 PM for The Halle (237 N. Salem St., Apex), dinner at Daniel's at 4:15 PM, leave by 5:30 PM for Raleigh Improv (1224 Parkside Main Street, Cary).
Route: Western Blvd/Chatham Street to downtown Cary; NC 55 between Apex and west Cary (route not checked against a routing service).
Parking was not verified at any stop.
The Halle's stored prices: $18 adult, $15 senior, $12 student (16 and under).
Bond Brothers lists the NC Burger food truck from noon on Sunday and says it has vegetarian options (event 48614d6c285e); no specific dish was verified.

itineraries.title: Durham Weekday Outdoors: Story of Stone at Duke Gardens, Anthony Cole Homestead Hike at Eno River, Madre Cumbia at Motorco
itineraries.theme: Two guided walks, one in a garden and one on a state park trail, followed by a Colombian cumbia concert
itineraries.drive_time: Duke Gardens is about 22 mi (straight line) northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 30-40 min by car. Eno River State Park's Fews Ford access is about 7 mi northwest of Duke Gardens, and Motorco is about 8 mi southeast of Fews Ford, roughly 15-20 min each (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Garden tour $22; hike price not in the store; concert $36.05; about $35-$45 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Tuesday is sunny with a high of 56°F and a 3% chance of rain. Have breakfast at Elmo's Diner on Ninth Street, then join founding curator Paul Jones for a two-hour walking tour of the stone features in Duke Gardens' Culberson Asiatic Arboretum at 10 AM. Have lunch at Foster's Market, then drive to Eno River State Park's Fews Ford access for a 2 PM ranger-led, 2.0-mile hike to the Anthony Cole Homestead. Have dinner at Goorsha, then see Los Gaiteros de San Jacinto, Fruko and Carmelo Torres at Motorco at 8 PM.

morning.title: The Story of Stone in the Culberson Asiatic Arboretum
morning.location: Duke Gardens-Barnes Welcome Center, 420 Anderson Street, Durham, NC 27705
morning.notes: 10 AM-noon. Walking tour led by Paul Jones, founding curator of the arboretum. Registration: https://rsvp.duke.edu/event/472241d5-c532-40d7-a180-552660d313b5/summary Info: https://gardens.duke.edu/event/the-story-of-stone-in-the-culberson-asiatic-arboretum/

afternoon.title: Anthony Cole Homestead Hike
afternoon.location: Eno River State Park - Fews Ford Access, 6101 Cole Mill Rd., Durham, NC 27705
afternoon.notes: 2-4 PM. A 2.0-mile hike with a ranger to the abandoned cabin off Buckquarter Creek Trail. Price is not in the store. Info: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/eno-river-state-park

evening.title: Los Gaiteros de San Jacinto, Fruko and Carmelo Torres Present: Madre Cumbia
evening.location: Motorco Music Hall, 723 Rigsbee Ave, Durham, NC, 27701
evening.notes: 8-11 PM. Colombian cumbia; presented by andmoreagain. Tickets: http://motorcomusic.com/event/madre-cumbia Info: https://www.andmoreagainpresents.com/calendar

food.vegetarian_dish: Veggie Breakfast Burrito (scrambled eggs, tomatoes, green peppers and onions in a flour tortilla with red sauce and melted cheese, sour cream, scallions, tomatoes)
food.notes: 776 9th Street, Durham NC 27705, about 1 mi from Duke Gardens. Own site: Monday-Friday 7 AM-3 PM. Own menu: Veggie Breakfast Burrito $8.90, served with frijoles and one breakfast side. Vegetarian by name and listed ingredients. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Avocado Toast (sliced avocado on toasted sourdough); vegan by listed ingredients, not labeled
food.vegetarian_dish: Fresh Mozzarella sandwich (fresh mozzarella, roasted red peppers, tomatoes, mixed baby greens, basil pesto, balsamic vinaigrette on a toasted soft baguette)
food.notes: 2694 Durham-Chapel Hill Blvd., Durham, NC. Own site: 9 AM-3 PM daily. Own menu: Fresh Mozzarella sandwich $12; Avocado Toast $7 (sliced avocado on toasted sourdough). The avocado toast has no animal products in its listed ingredients but is not labeled vegan. This is about 3 mi southwest of Duke Gardens, in the opposite direction from the Eno River; allow 30 minutes to reach Fews Ford.

food.vegan_dish: Vegan plate, choose three: Kik Alecha (yellow split pea stew), Gomen (collard greens), Yemisir Kik (red lentils in berbere)
food.vegetarian_dish: Same vegan plate; Sambusa appetizer $5 (pastry stuffed with lentils, onions, garlic and jalapeños)
food.notes: 910 West Main Street, Durham, NC 27701, about 1 mi from Motorco. Own site: Monday-Friday 5-9 PM. Own menu, section headed "Vegan": choose three for $17 from Kik Alecha, Gomen, Yemisir Kik, Tekil Gomen, Metin Shiro and Fosolia. The same page also lists "Vegan Options" at $14; confirm the price when ordering.

alternatives.leg: The Story of Stone tour at Duke Gardens (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, high 56°F; the 10 AM start will be in the 40s.
alternatives.rain: No indoor replacement was verified. Ask Duke Gardens whether the tour runs in rain (see the registration page).

alternatives.leg: Anthony Cole Homestead Hike at Eno River State Park (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and dry; wear shoes for an unpaved 2.0-mile trail.
alternatives.rain: No indoor replacement was verified for 2 PM. Rain is unlikely (3%); if the hike is cancelled, extend lunch and go to dinner when Goorsha opens at 5 PM.

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 7:45 AM for breakfast at Elmo's at about 8:30 AM; Duke Gardens' Barnes Welcome Center is at 420 Anderson Street.
Route: I-40 west to NC 147 north, exit toward Duke; Cole Mill Road north to the Fews Ford access at 6101 Cole Mill Rd. (route not checked against a routing service).
Parking was not verified at Duke Gardens, Eno River State Park or Motorco. Motorco has a parking page: https://motorcomusic.com/parking/
The hike listing gives no booking link; park page: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/eno-river-state-park
Door time for the Motorco show is not in the store.

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill Midweek: Ackland Art Museum Tour, Carrboro Farmers' Market, Our Town at PlayMakers
itineraries.theme: A weekday arts day: a free faculty-led museum tour, the last-but-one Wednesday farmers' market of the season, and a preview performance of Our Town
itineraries.drive_time: The Ackland Art Museum is about 25 mi (straight line) west-northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 35-45 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). Carrboro Town Commons is about 1.3 mi west of the Ackland; PlayMakers' Paul Green Theatre is about 0.5 mi east of it.
itineraries.cost_range: Museum, tour and market free; Our Town from $20; about $40-$50 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Wednesday is sunny with a high of 58°F and a low near 36°F at night. Have breakfast at Merritt's Grill, then see the Ackland Art Museum's galleries, which open at 10 AM. Have lunch at Tandem in Carrboro and return to the Ackland for the 1 PM tour, A Closer Look at Ackland Upstairs, on Asian art and historical research. The Carrboro Farmers' Market runs 3-5 PM at Town Commons. Have dinner at Akai Hana, then see the preview of Thornton Wilder's Our Town at PlayMakers Repertory Company at 7:30 PM.

morning.title: Ackland Art Museum galleries (self-guided; not a stored event)
morning.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 S. Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
morning.notes: Museum's visit page: admission is always free; open Wednesday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM. https://ackland.org/visit/

afternoon.title: Tour: A Closer Look at Ackland Upstairs
afternoon.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 S. Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
afternoon.notes: 1-2 PM. An hour-long conversation on Asian art at the Ackland and research in Asian and Middle Eastern history, with Dr. Morgan Pitelka and a second speaker. Info: https://events.ackland.org/event/nov2026-tour-a-closer-look-at-ackland-upstairs/

afternoon.title: Carrboro Farmers' Market (Wednesday)
afternoon.location: Carrboro Town Commons, 301 W Main Street, Carrboro, NC
afternoon.notes: 3-5 PM in November. The Wednesday market runs through the week before Thanksgiving. Kids' activities run at the same time (Market Bunch, event a013c03fb6cf). Info: https://www.carrborofarmersmarket.com/visit-us

evening.title: Our Town
evening.location: PlayMakers Repertory Company - Paul Green Theatre, 120 Country Club Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27599
evening.notes: Tagged as a preview performance. Tickets: https://tickets.playmakersrep.org/overview/15090 Info: https://playmakersrep.org/show/our-town/

food.vegetarian_dish: Egg and Cheese breakfast sandwich; Grandpa's Tomato (thick-sliced vine-ripened tomatoes, lettuce, mayo, salt and pepper), listed under Vegetarian Options
food.notes: 1009 South Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, about 1 mi south of the Ackland. Own site: Monday-Friday 7 AM-4 PM; breakfast until 10:30 AM. Own menu: Egg and Cheese $5.59; under "Vegetarian Options": Toasted Cheese $5.99, Grandpa's Tomato $6.59, Pimento Cheese $7.99. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Avocado Toast (avocado spread, tomato jam, eggplant, sunflower seeds, flax seeds, multigrain bread); vegan by listed ingredients, not labeled
food.vegetarian_dish: Grilled Cheese Sandwich (goat cheese, cheddar, provolone)
food.notes: 200 N Greensboro St #1a, Carrboro, NC 27510. Own site: lunch Tuesday-Saturday 11 AM-2:30 PM. Own lunch menu: Avocado Toast $18; Grilled Cheese Sandwich $18. Neither is labeled. The avocado toast has no animal products in its listed ingredients. Eat at 11:15 AM to be back at the Ackland by 1 PM.

food.vegetarian_dish: Vegetable Tempura (broccoli, sweet potato, carrot, onion, lightly battered, with tempura sauce)
food.notes: 206 W Main St, Carrboro, NC, one block from Town Commons. Own site: dinner Tuesday-Thursday 5-9 PM; no reservations. Own dinner menu: Vegetable Tempura entree $18.95; section headed "Vegetarian Appetizers" includes Vegetable Gyoza $6.95 and Seaweed Salad $4.95. The menu does not say whether the tempura sauce is vegetarian. No vegan dish verified.

alternatives.leg: Carrboro Farmers' Market at Town Commons (outdoor)
alternatives.rain: Stay at the Ackland after the tour; it is open until 5 PM on Wednesdays and is free.

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:15 AM for breakfast at Merritt's Grill at about 9 AM.
Route: I-40 west to NC 54 or US 15-501 into Chapel Hill (route not checked against a routing service).

Parking: the Ackland's visit page says parking is available at nearby municipal and private decks and at over 430 metered spaces within a 10-minute walk, and that weeknight parking in the Ackland's Porthole Alley lot requires a $1 permit. Parking at PlayMakers (120 Country Club Rd) and Carrboro Town Commons was not verified.
This itinerary repeats Akai Hana from Friday's Carrboro itinerary, at a different meal.
The Bends play Cat's Cradle at 8 PM the same night (event 1a411e498195; price not in the store) if theater tickets are gone.
